sgreuchwysgrechioskrkharjtocreakcfshriek.word: sgreuch, W. ysgrechio, Skr. kharj to creak. Cf. Shriek, v., Scream,

definitions.text: To utter a harsh, shrill cry; to make a sharp outcry, as in terror or acute pain; to scream; to shriek. "The screech owl, screeching loud." Shak.
Scratched; -- said of decorative painting of a certain style, in which a white overland surface is cut or scratched through, so as to form the design from a dark ground underneath.
